policy.privacy_content:
At Lightor, we respect our users' privacy and are committed to protecting their personal information.


Data Collection

When you book an appointment or leave an inquiry through the contact form, we collect the details you enter: your name and phone number and, depending on the form, the time and service you chose, your message and your answers to the business's own questions.


The details are collected directly from you and are used on behalf of the business you contacted.


Information Use

Your details are used only to handle your appointment or inquiry: confirmations, reminders and updates about an appointment, and passing an inquiry to the business owner, who may contact you about it. An inquiry is stored in the business's account and sent to the business owner the way they chose: notification, email, SMS or WhatsApp.


They are not used for other commercial purposes without your consent.


Information Transfer to Third Parties

We do not sell personal information and do not pass it to third parties, except the infrastructure providers that run the service and where the law or a court order requires it.


When you type in an address field on a booking or contact form, the text you type is sent to Google Maps Platform so that it can suggest addresses.


The business owner may use Lightor's AI assistant, which runs on Google Gemini, to manage appointments and inquiries. Your name, appointment time, service, message and answers may then be processed - but not your phone number, your email address or the address you entered in an address field.


Disclaimer

Use of the site is at the user's sole responsibility. Lightor will not be liable for any direct or indirect damage, including loss of information, resulting from site use or information provided through it.


The site may contain links to external sites – we have no control over them and are not responsible for their content or conduct.


Lightor's full privacy policy: lightor.app/privacy.html
policy.terms_content:
Use of the Lightor system constitutes full agreement by the user to the conditions detailed below:


System Use

The service is provided "As Is". We do not guarantee full availability or malfunction-free operation at all times.


The user is responsible for ensuring the information they enter is correct and up to date. Lightor is not responsible for consequences of incorrect information.


While using the system, you confirm receiving mailings/system messages/reminders through various media means.


Cancellations and No-Shows

Users are requested to cancel appointments according to operator conditions. Failure to arrive for an appointment may lead to charges or restriction on future use.


Waiver of Liability

Lightor will not be liable for any damage, direct or indirect, caused due to use or inability to use the system, including technical failures or availability.


All content on the site or system, including texts, images, or other information, are for illustration only and do not constitute professional advice or a binding legal document.
policy.security_content:
Lightor is committed to maintaining its users' data security using advanced security technologies and accepted protocols.


Encryption and Storage

Information is transferred to our servers in encrypted form and kept in a secure and protected environment.


Access to Information

Access to personal information is limited strictly to authorized staff who need it for service operation.


User Responsibility

The user should ensure they keep their passwords and identification means secret. Lightor will not be liable for damages resulting from unauthorized use of user identification details.


Waiver of Liability

Despite our efforts, absolute immunity from breaches or failures cannot be guaranteed. Use of the site and system is done at the user's sole responsibility.

statement.title: Accessibility statement
statement.intro: {{name}} wants this site to be accessible to people with disabilities. The site is built on the Lightor platform, operated by EZ Webs.
statement.level: We work to bring this site in line with WCAG 2.2 level AA and the Israeli Standard IS 5568 (level AA).
statement.done1: The site can be used with a keyboard alone.
statement.done2: The site is built to work with screen readers.
statement.done3: An accessibility menu: larger text, high contrast, stop animations, highlighted links, a readable font and text spacing.
statement.done4: The site follows your device's "reduce motion" setting.
statement.done5: Forms have labels and clear error messages.
statement.done6: The site works on phones and computers.
statement.limits: Some pictures added by the site's owner may not have a description yet. The site also uses third-party components, such as the security check and maps, that are not fully under our control.
